name: Aquarius-Treasury-Agent
description: Specialized treasury management agent. Monitors balances, executes approved disbursements, provides financial analysis and reporting. Implements secure multi-sig patterns and reputation-gated execution.

mcpEndpoints.name: getTreasuryState
mcpEndpoints.description: Queries current DAO treasury balances, allocations, and transaction history

mcpEndpoints.name: executeDisbursement
mcpEndpoints.description: Executes approved treasury transactions with multi-factor validation

mcpEndpoints.name: analyzeFinancials
mcpEndpoints.description: Provides AI-powered financial analysis and risk assessment

securityNotes.keyManagement: ERC-6551 TBA with ERC-4337 bundler integration. Transaction intents are validated by ReputationRegistry before execution. Goose uses read-only RPC for state queries.
